featured_reviews.name: Michael George
featured_reviews.review_text: Although often overlooked because of it's seemingly smaller premises, and lack of fancy fame, or over-the-top college culture and facilities, Dr. Antonio Da Silva is a more than worthy high school and junior college. I spent 2 amazing years at this place for my HSC. The teachers are truly concerned about the students, and the management has no bias or money motives. They provide top-notch quality education along with a bunch of opportunities to shine in extracurricular activities. The campus itself feels untouched by time, it's beautiful architecture and everyone is very polite and friendly, making the environment very comfortable for all. They'll go out of their way to help you. This is a truly underappreciated institution and it has silently being doing its job in giving high class services since many, many years.

featured_reviews.name: Vikas Mayekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Passed from 1997 batch. Reviews were not a thing then. But dare I see myself a very small person to review any institution like a School
My Teachers - Miss Pai - Marathi, Miss Rao- Hindi, Miss Irin Martin - English, Miss Bhalla- Maths, Miss Johnson - Science & Kennedy Sir - GMD & Sawant Sir - Turning. Rodricks miss for P.T. Rodrgues miss for History / Geography. Sorry if I missed anyone.
BEST 3 YEARS OF MY SCHOOLING
Sorry Johnson Miss, Kenedy Sir, Irin Miss (bless her soul) we were not well behaved at times (all the times).
The technical aspect has helped me lot in my life & career.
The teaching was amazing, discipline impeccable. My school friends am still in touch with. Can still remember Carvallo Sir who was principal then doing his rounds. The monsoon rain blazing in the corridors. In my time canteen could have been better.
Keep the good work going.

I do respect all the negative opinions on Google reviews, but this is a 125 year old institution you are blaming for your kids lack of success. Reflect upon it.

Miss martha n miss sylvania were very kind but strict with vis a vis studies. Moral science classes earlier it was for non catholics. Yes now i m 74 yrs sr citizen n my best friend was Lancelot Almeida who was gud in french n weak in marathi n i was opp gud in marathi n weak in french so we both used to share a very gud rapport. Our school timings mon to wed n fri sat was 9.30 to 4.30 n thursdays half days leave at 1.30pm. Those were d days. Lunch time was 1.00 to 2.00..ah miss my young days n school life. Our dvns were A TO D. Miss u all ex-antonios

featured_reviews.name: Mit
featured_reviews.review_text:
My child had the best 2 years in Busy Bees! She has learnt so many things, it blows my mind. She has become a curious little problem solver and an independent thinker.

All the activities they did at the school through the year were fun and creative and built the children's knowledge and personality.

She absolutely adores her teachers and cried to go to school on school holidays. All the teachers have been so loving and patient and take each child's individual temperament into consideration. The love and guidance she has received from here is more than I could have hoped for.

Safe to say that we will (all) miss Busy Bees and wish them only the best ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Anthea Dabreo
featured_reviews.review_text: Enrolling our daughter in Busy Bees Montessori Schoolhas been one of the best decisions we've made as parents. Over the past few months, we’ve seen such a beautiful transformation in her—especially in her vocabulary and communication skills. She’s started using new words confidently, forming sentences we never thought we’d hear so soon! Beyond just academics, the school has played a huge role in teaching her essential daily habits—like putting on her shoes, packing up her bag, and even helping out with little chores at home. The environment is warm, welcoming, and truly focused on each child’s growth at their own pace. We feel incredibly lucky to have found such a caring and dedicated team. Thank you for creating such a strong foundation for our little one!

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for the exceptional teaching methods and care provided to my son. The incredible teachers of Busy Bees along with their  dedication and innovative approach have made a significant impact on my son's growth and development from the day he joined till this last working day. Your Montessori approach has fostered his curiosity, independence, and love for learning. We're grateful for the dedicated care and support.

Thank you for shaping his future!

featured_reviews.name: Anna Lestourgeon
featured_reviews.review_text:
We couldn’t have asked for a more loving and nurturing start to our son's early learning journey. Busy Bees has felt like a warm extension of our home, and our little one settled right in from day one. A big shoutout to Teachers Sherlyn and Kim, who bring so much heart into everything they do. They make learning feel like play while gently guiding each child’s growth. The way they bring every festival and little celebration to life with so much love and fun is just the sweetest thing.
We’re so grateful for the safe, inspiring environment Busy Bees offers, and the confidence and curiosity it’s already sparking in our little one.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a thoughtful, hands-on Montessori experience that truly cares about every child’s development.

featured_reviews.name: Alysha Serpis
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely no regrets registering my child at Busy Bees School! The teachers and the environment is tailored to each child's individual progress and needs. The teachers are so patient and understanding and are truly invested in the child's well being. I have seen tremendous growth in my child and wholeheartedly recommend this school to any parent looking for an all rounded and nurturing environment for early years education.

featured_reviews.name: Batul Fatakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text: My son had a great time learning at busy bee ! It’s a safe space and a very warm environment. Teachers are loving and caring and I would definitely recommend this Montessori to others

featured_reviews.name: stephie D'souza
featured_reviews.review_text: Busy Bees Montessori School really looks into every child's needs and very beautifully works on it through the year to achieve those skills. The hands on activities throughout the year encourages every child to develop their motor skills and gives them a first hand experience of the environment. Busy Bees is a wonderful School to get your child ready socially, emotionally and physically for the next step ahead. All the teachers are very kind, caring and ensure very child is happy and feels safe. I would highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Shifa Uttanwala
featured_reviews.review_text: An exceptional Montessori school that provides individual attention to each child, ensuring a smooth and joyful transition into the world of learning. The teachers are incredibly caring, dedicated, and supportive, creating a nurturing environment where children truly thrive. A truly wonderful school in every sense.
